name: message-timestamps
description: Show when each user and assistant message was sent

formatToday.title: Format: today
formatToday.description: For messages from today. Tokens: YYYY YY MMM MM M DD D ddd HH H hh h mm m ss s A a Z, and relative. Text in [brackets] is shown as written.

formatWeek.title: Format: last 6 days
formatWeek.description: For messages from the 6 days before today. Same tokens as Format: today.

formatYear.title: Format: this year
formatYear.description: For older messages from this year. Same tokens as Format: today.

formatOlder.title: Format: earlier years
formatOlder.description: For messages from before this year. Same tokens as Format: today.

formatHover.title: Format: on hover
formatHover.description: Shown in place of the timestamp while the pointer is on it. Same tokens as Format: today. Empty turns the hover off.

refreshSeconds.title: Relative time refresh (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often each timestamp is brought up to date.
